onMiss: Read the flagged slices and the evidence in ~/Documents/Github/auto-sns-agent/.cache/duties/dm-extension/latest (autopair.log, e2e.log, each evidence.json and the screenshots), and name the cause in one line. Each miss gets one fix job in this chat (chrome extension, 39ca7bbb-37a8-47e5-a06a-d6cea515b3cc) unless one is live: start it with rlm.create_session, or steer the live one. The fix job works in the us-metal02 checkout on dev/sieun, commits with scripts/repo/agent/commit.mjs, and proves the fix with this duty's next run. An e2e_part slice is the extension (apps/dm-extension/src), its server routes (apps/search/src/routes/api/dm/extension, convex/search/dmDevices.ts and dmOutreach.ts) or the Connections and Inbox pages; read which part failed first. A maybe_sent, send_restricted or unknown_username slice names its rows: find why the extension or the server settled them that way. A source_error slice is the measure itself (a jar the prod crawler no longer holds, an ssh or Convex CLI failure, a clean world that did not come up, a rig bug): fix this precheck or the rig. An account the crawler parked or whose jar went invalid is not ours to sign in again: a password sign-in needs the metal box owner's ok in the Crawler VP chat, so pick another active test account in SENDER_ID or REPLIER_ID instead. Test DMs go only between the crawler's own test accounts; never DM a real person and never get around an Instagram checkpoint. Prod changes ship in the release the release owner walks with the owner (c154). All on target: end the turn with no message.
